situation: Quantizing MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash) for memory fit.
decision: For MoE models, quantization reduces storage but ALL 320B parameters (all experts) still occupy memory even though only ~18B activate per token.
reasoning_physics: Expert sparsity is an activate-time savings, not a resident-memory savings. All experts must be loadable; quant lowers each expert's bytes but none can be paged out during active decode. So footprint ≈ total params × bits, not active × bits.
